output.review_comment: Request changes: (1) Add a PR description explaining what was broken and how the fix addresses it; (2) Confirm tests pass and show test output; (3) Explain the rounding behavior change from "round half up" to banker's rounding and why this matches the spec; (4) Explain why the new validation constraint (slot_minutes must divide MINUTES_PER_DAY) is required. The rounding change appears to be specifically to match test expectations, which needs clear justification.
